benchmarkDefinition: P_t/P_previous plus gross cash entitlement D_t/P_previous, equivalently (P_t+D_t)/P_previous, reinvested at ex-date close. Before investor distribution tax; ETF expenses already embedded in market prices; registered benchmark trade costs remain separate.

stockRules.scope: Every date and horizon; outcome-blind symmetric refusal. Universe identity and verified raw-KRX non-price/accounting information are retained. Selected unpriceable name blocks the paired economics.
